# Eigenheit 7

A quirk: the roll as a badge where the right icon would be, the text as
the body. Invented for this deck.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: mini-d20
  card-type: quirk
  language: de
data:
  name: Namensgedächtnis
  roll: "7"
  roll-min: 7
  roll-max: 7
  description: "Du sprichst von dir stets in der dritten Person und vergisst nie einen Namen."
  reference: Regelwerk S. 15
```
